# META-INSIGHTS — about the optimization PROCESS itself (this run)

Not about the capability — about HOW this run is searching for it: which strategies/edit classes/algorithms are helping vs stalling, and what to try next iteration. Update at the end of the run at minimum; sooner if a plateau or a clear strategy shift is worth recording now. Structure each addition as:

    ## Iteration <id> (or 'run so far')
    - Strategy tried, and whether it moved val (cite LEDGER rows):
    - Plateau/stall signal, if any, and the lever switched to:
    - What to try next iteration:

<!-- cap-evolve:meta-insights-append-below -->

## Iteration cand_0001 (run so far)
- Strategy tried: decode the reward first, THEN pick edits. Confirmed reward = DB × COMMUNICATE and
  that `action_checks` are informational (passing tasks carry action_match=False). This reframed the
  whole search: a task whose DB already matches (task 11) is fixed ONLY by a COMMUNICATE edit — i.e. by
  giving the agent the correct NUMBER, not by touching any write. That is invisible if you read
  `action_checks` as pass/fail.
- Edit classes used: two NEW code-bearing tools (a compute/quote tool + a loop tool). Deliberately NOT
  a guard: none of the failing DB tasks is a bad-arg-to-a-called-write; they are mis-selection (wrong
  reservation) and episode-end stalls, which guards can't touch.
- Plateau/stall signal: n/a (first iteration).
- What to try next: (1) if val moved little, the COMMUNICATE-number class is the highest-yield remaining
  lever — audit every failing task for a required numeric `communicate_check` and ensure a tool returns
  that exact number. (2) The stall class (25/40) is likely NOT fixable in the tool surface — flag to the
  run that those need the instruction/policy capability, not tools. (3) Consider whether adding tools
  hurt selection on passing tasks (watch LEDGER `broke=`); if so, keep the quote tool, drop the loop tool.
